title: Greaves gives a ten-power creature haste for the exact kill
briefing: P2 is at 10 with no creatures. P1 has eight Forests, Gigantosaurus (10/10, five green mana here) and Lightning Greaves (cast {2}, equip {0}, haste and shroud). Cast alone the giant is summoning sick. Greaves, the giant, an equip and an attack is 7 of 8 mana and exactly 10 damage.

reference.analysis: Greaves gives haste, so the giant can attack the turn it is cast. Cost: 2 for Greaves, 5 for the giant, equip is free: 7 of 8 mana. 10 damage at a player on 10 is lethal; without Greaves the giant cannot attack.

lines.label: Greaves, Gigantosaurus, equip, attack P2
lines.why: 10 hasty trample-free damage at a player on 10.

lines.label: Cast Gigantosaurus without Greaves
lines.why: The giant is summoning sick and cannot attack; the Greaves in hand would have made it lethal.
